comment: Each mute button is a four-position parameter (PolyMuter8Plus.cpp:219-226): Unmuted, Solo, Solo/Mute, Muted, which is how one button carries both states. The first button's value list names position 2 'Solo' where the other seven name it 'Solo/Mute'. Unlike the non-plus version there is no 'exclude -10v chans too' item. The README adds that when MIDI mapped, exactly +10V mutes and 3.4V to 9.9V soloes; that mapping is Rack's own parameter scaling and is not a figure in this source. The IN and OUT jacks carry whatever is patched, so they get no family.
